rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for influencing or changing something, and it is also the natural everyday choice when an illness harms an organ.

example.english: This will affect whether I can get to work tomorrow.
example.traditional: 呢件事會影響我聽日返工。
example.jyutping: nei1 gin6 si6 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 ngo5 ting1 jat6 faan1 gung1
